0022600136.text: The Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the East) visit the Toronto Raptors (2-1, 4th in the East) in their fourth game of the season, with Orlando 1-0 on the road, 0-2 at home, and on a W1 streak, while Toronto is on an L1 streak after going 2-1 in its last three. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), and Jalen Suggs is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Orlando lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, including a 139-87 loss in Toronto on March 29, 2026.
